'''Beta Squadron''' was a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] squadron in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It served at the [[Evacuation of Gelgelar|attack on Gelgelar]] and was destroyed against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].
